integrity: All claimed all-level formulas have a mathematical proof; included finite checker gives corroboration only. Self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns distinct linear factors at lengths 2^k, k>=4, of the regular binary paperfolding word.
It does not assert non-dyadic, alternate folding-instruction, occurrence-weighted or higher-order Abelian analogues.
Uses Allouche 1992 factor-complexity theorem (4N for N>=7) as an established mathematical dependency.
Historical priority remains qualified because full text of the 1994 canonical-position paper was not inspected.
title: Twelve dyadic 2-Abelian ambiguity classes in the regular paperfolding word
